feeds.title: International Mission Board
feeds.description: The International Mission Board partners with churches to empower limitless missionary teams to make disciples and multiply churches among unreached peoples.

feeds.title: Ethnos360
feeds.description: The latest Christian mission news from around the world. Through Ethnos360, Christian missionaries do Bible translation and evangelism to plant churches among unreached people groups around the world. Ethnos360 helps local churches train, coordinate and send missionaries to these groups.

feeds.title: A Life Overseas
feeds.description: The blog collective 'A Life Overseas' provides that place of online connection for Christ-following missionaries and humanitarian aid workers living in foreign countries from the past, present, or future.

feeds.title: Family Missions Company Blog
feeds.description: Compelled by Jesus' missionary mandate, and filled with the Holy Spirit, Family Missions Company missionaries proclaim Jesus Christ and His Gospel to the poor. Always working in concert with the pastors of the Catholic Church, we strive to live the Gospel that we preach.

feeds.title: Bill Hutchison
feeds.description: Bill Hutchison works with Youth With A Mission (YWAM) International and writes about his experiences and thoughts on this site.

feeds.title: Christian Aid Mission
feeds.description: Since 1953, Christian Aid Mission has worked to establish a witness for Christ in every nation by assisting highly effective indigenous ministries in lands of poverty, where Christians are a persecuted minority, and where foreign missionaries are not allowed.

feeds.title: TEAM Christian Missions Blog
feeds.description: Exploring cross-cultural ministry around the globe.TEAM partners with churches to send missionaries and establish reproducing churches among the nations, to the glory of God.

feeds.title: Jamie Wright | Christian Missionary's Blog
feeds.description: This blog contain the deconstruction of my faith, the foibles and failures of my life, and, occasionally, moments of triumph, grace, and humility. From my opinions on the dumpster fire we call Christian missions to a tutorial for baking a pie into a cake, around here you'll find a little bit of everything.

feeds.title: Natalie In Guatemala Blog
feeds.description: Natalie In Guatemala is all about Teaching English and Sharing Jesus.

feeds.title: Mission Quest Blog
feeds.description: Mission Quest is a missionary service agency that was established by missionaries for missionaries. We help missionaries processing donations.
